title: VLM Latency Characterization Record
description: Per-inference record emitted by run_vlm_latency_benchmark.sh and consumed by vlm_latency_report.py. Fields unavailable from the runtime are represented as null — they are never inferred or fabricated.

run_id.description: Unique run identifier (timestamp-based), shared across all records in one benchmark invocation.

recorded_at.description: ISO 8601 wall-clock timestamp when this inference record was written.

condition.description: Experiment condition label from the matrix (e.g. A, B, C, D, E).

path.description: Invocation path: 'direct' for native Edge-LLM cold-start invocation, 'ipc' for persistent edge_vlm_server via IPC socket.

lifecycle_semantics.description: Lifecycle phase measured: 'cold_start' for direct (includes per-process init), 'persistent' for ipc (steady-state against running server). Null for records written before this field was introduced.

image_id.description: Stable identifier for the input image (filename stem or content hash prefix).

image_path.description: Absolute or relative path to the input image file used for this inference.

image_width_px.description: Effective image width in pixels after any resize applied before encoding.

image_height_px.description: Effective image height in pixels after any resize applied before encoding.

prompt_hash.description: Short SHA-256 hex prefix of the exact prompt text used, for reproducibility verification.

max_output_tokens.description: Maximum number of output tokens requested from the model.

actual_output_tokens.description: Actual number of output tokens generated. Null if the runtime does not expose this.

success.description: True when inference completed without error.

error.description: Error message when success is false; null otherwise.

total_latency_ms.description: Measured end-to-end wall-clock latency in milliseconds from inference request to response received. Null on failure.

visual_preprocess_ms.description: Visual preprocessing / encoder time in milliseconds. Null if not exposed by the runtime.

ttft_ms.description: Time-to-first-token (prompt prefill latency) in milliseconds. Null if not exposed by the runtime. Never inferred.

decode_ms.description: Autoregressive decode phase duration in milliseconds. Null if not exposed by the runtime.

decode_tokens_per_sec.description: Decode throughput in tokens per second. Null if actual_output_tokens or decode_ms is unavailable.

iteration.description: Zero-based iteration index within this condition/path/image combination.

warmup.description: True when this record is a warmup iteration that should be excluded from aggregate statistics.

tegrastats.description: Optional synchronized tegrastats snapshot captured during this inference.
